description: Saves a style note on one of the person's submitted attempts: a short title and one or two sentences on how they work, optionally with one stamp. Private to the person.

body.description: One or two sentences, in their voice.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

stamp_kind.description: Optional. One stamp naming the way of working the evidence shows. primary_source: Went to the original record rather than anyone else’s account of it. field_work: Left the desk — looked at the thing itself, in the place it is. cross_reference: Held two unrelated sources against each other and found the seam. close_reading: Stayed with one artefact long enough to notice what a scan would miss. counter_case: Went looking for the example that would break their own explanation. synthesis: Built a frame that holds the pieces, rather than listing them.

title.description: A short title, e.g. "How they dig in".

name: store_style_note
title: Save a Style Note
